info.title: Policy
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

cfg_entries.description:
Reference Resource: [Policy_Entry](#/Policy_Entry)
Policy entries as configured by the user. For a child Policy, the configured Policy entries are located in the parent Policy and this value is ignored. An empty column value indicates that no match criteria is specified for this list.

cfg_version.description: The version of 'cfg_entries' that should be changed to a random value each time 'cfg_entries' is modified.  For a child Policy, the parent Policy's version of 'cfg_entries' is used and this value is ignored. An empty column value will indicate that the user does not want the system to process this configuration yet.

cur_entries.description:
Reference Resource: [Policy_Entry](#/Policy_Entry)
Policy entries that are currently programmed in the data path.

global_conform_rate.description: This is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. It is available at [Policy](#/Policy).

global_in_conform_rates.description: Per Policy entry conform rate in kilobits per second, on ingress direction for the global Policy. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled and Policy-specific 'cir' action.

global_statistics.description: This is deprecated and will be removed in a future release. It is available at [Policy](#/Policy).

in_progress_entries.description:
Reference Resource: [Policy_Entry](#/Policy_Entry)
Policy entries that are being processed for installation into the data path.

in_progress_version.description: The version of the 'in_progress' Classifier Policy.  This value is copied from 'cfg_version' when the Policy processing begins. This value is cleared when the Policy status is updated to 'applied' or 'rejected.'

interfaces_in_conform_rates.description: Per Policy entry conform rates in kilobits per second, summarized across interfaces on ingress direction where Policy is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled and Policy-specific 'cir' action.

interfaces_in_statistics.description: Per Policy entry hit counts, summarized across interfaces on ingress direction where Policy is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled.

interfaces_out_conform_rates.description: Per Policy entry conform rates in kilobits per second, summarized across interfaces on egress direction where Policy is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled and Policy-specific 'cir' action.

interfaces_out_statistics.description: Per Policy entry hit counts, summarized across interfaces on egress direction where Policy is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled.

interfaces_routed_in_conform_rates.description: Per Policy entry conform rates in kilobits per second, summarized per VRF for route-only interfaces on routed ingress direction where Policy is attached. Only applies to the Policy entries with Policy-specific 'cir' action.

interfaces_routed_in_statistics.description: Per Policy entry hit counts, summarized per VRF for route-only interfaces on routed ingress direction where Policy is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled.

name.description:
Reference Resource: [Policy](#/Policy)
Name of a Classifier Policy (Policy).

origin.description: Origin of the Policy, i.e., how the Policy is provisioned:  `synthesized`: Policy has been dynamically synthesized                 by the system.  `static`     : Policy is provisioned by the administrator                 via CLI or REST.

parent_policy.description:
Reference Resource: [Policy](#/Policy)
For a child Policy, this is the reference to the configured parent [Policy](#/Policy). The 'cfg_entries' and 'cfg_version' of the parent Policy will be used instead of the child Policy's. For a parent/standalone policy, this column should be empty.

routed_in_statistics_clear_performed.description: The number of times a request was performed to clear the routed-in statistics for this Policy for each application type and VRF.

routed_in_statistics_clear_requested.description: The number of times a request was made to clear the routed-in statistics for this Policy for each application type and VRF.

statistics_clear_performed.description: The number of times a request was performed to clear the statistics for this Policy for each application type or 'all' application types including routed-in Policies.

statistics_clear_requested.description: The number of times a request was made to clear the statistics for this Policy for each application type or 'all' application types.

statistics_requested_vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
Indicates the specific VRF requested for the interfaces_routed_in_statistics or l3vnis_routed_in_statistics or vlans_routed_in_statistics on-demand query.

code.description: Numeric error code.  Expected to be 0 when state is 'applied'

message.description: Detailed reason for error state.  Expected empty when state is 'applied'

version.description: The version of cfg_entries that corresponds to this status.

vlans_in_conform_rates.description: Per Policy entry conform rates in kilobits per second, summarized across VLANs on ingress direction where Policy is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled and Policy-specific 'cir' action.

vlans_in_statistics.description: Per Policy entry hit counts, summarized across vlans on ingress direction where Policy is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled.

vlans_out_conform_rates.description: Per Policy entry conform rates in kilobits per second, summarized across VLANs on egress direction where Policy is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled and Policy-specific 'cir' action.

vlans_out_statistics.description: Per Policy entry hit counts, summarized across vlans on egress direction where Policy is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled.

vlans_routed_in_conform_rates.description: Per Policy entry conform rates in kilobits per second, summarized per VRF for route-only vlans on routed ingress direction where Policy is attached. Only applies to the Policy entries with Policy-specific 'cir' action.

vlans_routed_in_statistics.description: Per Policy entry hit counts, summarized per VRF for route-only vlans on routed ingress direction where Policy is attached. Only applies to the entries with counting enabled.

vsx_sync.description: Controls which attributes should be synchronized between VSX peers. 'all_attributes_and_dependents': the entire policy and its entries should be synchronized. This column value should be empty when system should not synchronize attributes between VSX peers.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)
